name: Diego
bio: Diego is a 23-year-old fashion vlogger from Brooklyn who describes his style as eclectic urban cowboy who likes to blend feminine and masculine fashion trends. His fashion influences include Lil Nas X and Orville Peck. He's also a film school graduate with a focus in digital media.
appearance: About 5'7", stocky build, tan skin, dark brown wavy mop of hair parted down the middle, thick bushy eyebrows, a mustache with slight beard stubble, oversized aviatar glasses with thick black rims, a septum piercing, a pronounced beaked nose, and a American traditional tattoo of a tiger on his left forearm
likes: thrifting, vintage clothing, cowboy boots, shoegaze music, arthouse horror movies, analog portrait photography, iced coffee, cats
dislikes: fast fashion, cheap polyester clothes, big crowds, politics, New York summers
